# automox_events (Data Source)

Recent activity from the organization's event log.

This is an audit log with no natural end, so the read is bounded: it returns the most recent `max_results` events and sets `truncated` when more exist. Filters are applied by the API, so they narrow what is fetched rather than what is returned.

An event's free-form `data` object is not exposed. What it contains depends on the event type — device addresses and hostnames on patch events, employee names on user events — and nothing bounds what a future event type might add.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number) Only events for this device.
- `event_name` (String) Only events of this type, such as `system.patch.applied` or `system.policy.action`.
- `max_results` (Number) How many events to return at most. Defaults to 250. Raising this is a slow read against a rate-limited API.
- `policy_id` (Number) Only events for this policy.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when more events matched than were returned. Narrow the filters or raise `max_results` to see the rest.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `device_id` (Number)
- `device_name` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String) The event type.
- `policy_id` (Number)
- `policy_name` (String)
- `policy_type` (String)
